purpose: Govern LLM-generated amusement park event plans across placement, timing, staffing, equipment, crowd flow, risk identification, deployment suggestions, and normal ride operations.

decision_rules.name: Temporary Placement Feasibility
decision_rules.condition: A plan places scare zones, mazes, pop-up food, merch, barriers, lighting, fog, photo ops, or shows.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Place experiences where capacity, access, utilities, staff, emergency routes, and normal ride operations can support them.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Place queues, equipment, food lines, or scare zones where they block emergency access, accessibility routes, parade routes, or critical operations.
human_review_if: event attendance exceeds baseline staffing plan
parade or emergency route could be affected

decision_rules.name: Temporal Flow Planning
decision_rules.condition: A temporary event plan spans multiple time blocks.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Plan arrival, family, peak, exit, food, and show waves with stage-by-stage staffing and routing.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Treat event crowd movement as static or ignore peak-time transitions.
human_review_if: exit wave overlaps ride closure or weather risk
maze queue spills into normal ride operations

decision_rules.name: Plan Revision From Outcomes
decision_rules.condition: Take rate, crowd movement, worker acknowledgement, equipment application, or GCP internal eval indicates weak assumptions.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Create a revised event plan version that changes placement, staffing, equipment, or message strategy.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Repeat a plan after evidence shows low take rate, bottleneck creation, staff overload, or equipment infeasibility.
human_review_if: revision changes safety, route, or staffing constraints

decision_rules.name: Family-Safe Creative Fit
decision_rules.condition: A creative event concept changes theme, scare intensity, guest segment targeting, show content, or promotional framing.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Keep creative ideas compatible with audience windows, accessibility, staffing, capacity, and published park standards.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Suggest creative concepts that ignore family-safe windows, accessibility needs, crowd capacity, brand restrictions, or operator approvals.
human_review_if: content intensity changes by time block
theme may affect children or sensitive guests
creative plan adds staffing, security, or route controls
